title: Preservation of the root-of-unity inverse limit
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] and $\ell$ a prime invertible in every residue field of $X$ and $Y$. On the small pro-etale site of $Y$, let $M:\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Sh}(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathbf{Ab})$ have $M_n=\mu_{\ell^{n+1},Y}$, the kernel of the $(\ell^{n+1})$-power map on the unit sheaf, and successor transition $z\mapsto z^\ell$ [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf]. Then the abelian-sheaf inverse image $h^{-1}$ preserves the limit of $M$: the canonical map $h^{-1}\varprojlim_n M_n\to\varprojlim_n h^{-1}M_n$ is an isomorphism. No preservation of arbitrary infinite limits is asserted. Site objects have universe $u+1$, site morphisms universe $u$, and abelian values universe $u+1$, as in the recorded inverse-image definition.

source.place: Roots of unity and Integral twist paragraphs.

proof.text: Use the pro-etale cover with compatible primitive roots; these give compatible bases of each root module over its finite constant ring.
Weakly etale localization identifies the covering slices with the pro-etale sites of the covering schemes. The normalized slice inverse-image maps transport the bases.

On small site models apply the compatible-free-tower theorem. Its coefficient comparison is invertible by the normalized base-completion result. The resulting underlying-set module comparison is therefore invertible. Raise values by ULift when passing to the small model; the canonical fully faithful lifted sheaf and inverse-image comparisons preserve the relevant limits and reflect invertibility. Descend the comparison back to the original value universe.

Transport back to the original sites; the forgetful functors preserve limits and reflect isomorphisms. The comparison-isomorphism criterion is precisely preservation of the displayed root-tower limit. The base-changed cover covers X, including the empty case.

    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]

    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
